description: A set of small flathead and Phillips screwdrivers, sized for electronics work.
how_to_use: Match the tip shape and size to the screw, then turn clockwise to tighten or counterclockwise to loosen — used for screw-terminal connections rather than breadboard work.

plain.what: Tiny screwdrivers for small screws and for turning the adjusting screws on sensor boards.
plain.how: Pick the tip that fits the screw exactly, so you don't damage it.
